Pappas
changeSet.sql: if not exists (select 1 from [sys].[key_constraints] where name = 'UQ_Semantic_Qualifier_EffectiveDate') begin ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Semantic] add constraint UQ_Semantic_Qualifier_EffectiveDate UNIQUE (Qualifier, EffectiveDate) end

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Semantic_Qualifier') begin CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Semantic_Qualifier] ON [dbo].[Semantic] ( [Qualifier] ASC ) end

changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql: if not exists (SELECT * FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[Semantic]') AND name = N'IX_dbo_Semantic_Uid') begin CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_dbo_Semantic_Uid] ON [dbo].[Semantic] ( [Uid] ASC ) end
changeSet.rollback: if exists (SELECT * FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[Semantic]') AND name = N'IX_dbo_Semantic_Uid') BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_dbo_Semantic_Uid] ON [dbo].[Semantic] END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: update T set T.Uid = S.Uid from Semantic T inner join ( select S1.Uid, S1.Qualifier from Semantic S1 inner join ( select min(ID) as ID, Qualifier from Semantic group by Qualifier ) S2 on S2.ID = S1.ID ) S on S.Qualifier = T.Qualifier;
